description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC REST controller class 'ShopProductRESTController' that handles API endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting products, manufacturers, options, and reviews within an e-commerce system. It interacts with various services for business logic and data persistence related to products, categories, manufacturers, and reviews.

classes.name: ShopProductRESTController
classes.description: Controller class providing REST API endpoints for managing products, manufacturers, options, reviews, and product queries in an e-commerce Spring MVC application.

methods.name: createProduct
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new product for a specific merchant store, populating the domain model and saving it via the ProductService.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a product by ID if it belongs to the specified store.

methods.name: createManufacturer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new manufacturer associated with a store.

methods.name: createProductOption
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new product option (like size, color).

methods.name: createProductOptionValue
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new product option value (like 'Red' for color).

methods.name: createProductReview
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a customer review for a product, with validation for existing reviews and rating limits.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of products for a given store and category, supporting language, paging, and category hierarchy.

methods.name: getProductsFilteredByType
methods.description: Retrieves filtered products by a specified filter type (e.g., brand) within a category for a store.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Internal helper method to fetch products based on pagination, filters, and category hierarchy, returning formatted product data.
